user_story: As a user, I want to receive an error when I try to reset the password with an unregistered email so that I know the email is not in the system.

positive.title: Reset password for a registered email
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
positive.expected_result: An email with password reset instructions is sent to the registered email address

negative.title: Attempt to reset password with an unregistered email
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating that the email is not in the system is displayed

negative.title: Attempt to reset password with an empty email field
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating that the email field cannot be empty is displayed

negative.title: Attempt to reset password with an invalid email format
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
negative.expected_result: An error message indicating that the email format is invalid is displayed

edge.title: Reset password with a very long email address
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
Enter a very long email address (greater than 254 characters)
edge.expected_result: An error message indicating that the email is too long is displayed

edge.title: Reset password with a special character email
steps: Navigate to the password reset page
Enter an email address with special characters that are valid (e.g., 'test.email+alex@leetcode.com')
edge.expected_result: An email with password reset instructions is sent to the registered email address, if it is in the system
